Table "public"."access_logs" {
  "access_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "data_id" INTEGER
  "access_date" TEXT
  "access_type" TEXT
  "ip_address" TEXT
  "user_agent" TEXT
}

Table "public"."adherence_rates" {
  "adherence_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "regimen_id" INTEGER
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "time" INTEGER
  "adherence_rate" REAL
  "reason_for_non_adherence" TEXT
  "intervention_effectiveness" REAL
}

Table "public"."bednet_distributions" {
  "distribution_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "distribution_date" TEXT
  "number_distributed" INTEGER
  "distributor_id" INTEGER
  "distribution_method" TEXT
  "feedback" TEXT
  "coverage_percentage" REAL
}

Table "public"."clinical_trials" {
  "trial_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "intervention_id" INTEGER
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "start_date" TEXT
  "end_date" TEXT
  "number_of_participants" INTEGER
  "results" TEXT
  "trial_status" TEXT
  "trial_design" TEXT
}

Table "public"."distributors" {
  "distributor_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "distributor_name" TEXT
  "contact_email" TEXT
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "phone_number" TEXT
  "address" TEXT
}

Table "public"."external_data" {
  "data_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "data_type" TEXT
  "data_source" TEXT
  "data_file" TEXT
  "data_description" TEXT
  "data_collection_date" TEXT
}

Table "public"."field_reports" {
  "report_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_id" INTEGER
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "report_date" TEXT
  "report_text" TEXT
  "intervention_id" INTEGER
  "latitude" REAL
  "longitude" REAL
  "feedback" TEXT
}

Table "public"."intervention_costs" {
  "cost_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "intervention_id" INTEGER
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "cost_date" TEXT
  "total_cost" REAL
  "cost_breakdown" TEXT
  "funding_received" REAL
}

Table "public"."intervention_effectiveness" {
  "effectiveness_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "intervention_id" INTEGER
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "time" INTEGER
  "effectiveness_score" REAL
  "impact_on_prevalence" REAL
  "impact_on_mortality" REAL
}

Table "public"."interventions" {
  "intervention_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "intervention_name" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
  "start_date" TEXT
  "end_date" TEXT
  "target_population" TEXT
  "funding_source" TEXT
  "status" TEXT
}

Table "public"."malaria_cases" {
  "case_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "report_date" TEXT
  "number_of_cases" INTEGER
  "intervention_id" INTEGER
  "age_group" TEXT
  "gender" TEXT
}

Table "public"."malaria_deaths" {
  "death_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "report_date" TEXT
  "number_of_deaths" INTEGER
  "intervention_id" INTEGER
  "age_group" TEXT
  "gender" TEXT
}

Table "public"."public_health_surveys" {
  "survey_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "survey_date" TEXT
  "number_of_respondents" INTEGER
  "malaria_prevalence" REAL
  "intervention_id" INTEGER
  "survey_method" TEXT
  "survey_design" TEXT
}

Table "public"."regimens" {
  "regimen_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "regimen_name" TEXT
  "description" TEXT
  "dosing_schedule" TEXT
  "side_effects" TEXT
  "duration" INTEGER
  "cost" REAL
}

Table "public"."regions" {
  "region_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "region_name" TEXT
  "country" TEXT
  "population" INTEGER
  "geographic_area" TEXT
  "latitude" REAL
  "longitude" REAL
  "elevation" INTEGER
}

Table "public"."time_series_data" {
  "data_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "intervention_id" INTEGER
  "region_id" INTEGER
  "time" INTEGER
  "coverage" REAL
  "regimen" TEXT
  "bednets" INTEGER
  "adherence" REAL
  "malaria_prevalence" REAL
  "temperature" REAL
  "rainfall" REAL
}

Table "public"."users" {
  "user_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "user_name" TEXT
  "email" TEXT
  "role" TEXT
  "phone_number" TEXT
  "last_login" TEXT
  "status" TEXT
}

Ref: "public"."access_logs"."data_id" > "public"."time_series_data"."data_id"
Ref: "public"."access_logs"."user_id" > "public"."users"."user_id"

Ref: "public"."intervention_effectiveness"."intervention_id" > "public"."interventions"."intervention_id"
Ref: "public"."intervention_effectiveness"."region_id" > "public"."regions"."region_id"
Ref: "public"."malaria_cases"."region_id" > "public"."regions"."region_id"

Ref: "public"."malaria_deaths"."intervention_id" > "public"."interventions"."intervention_id"
